fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Buses/BusListing.cy.js#Buses - BusListing [ashokLeylandBuses] [en] — Ashok Leyland Buses TC-BUS-04: listing heading, filters and cards on Ashok Leyland Buses
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BUS-04
**Title:** listing heading, filters and cards on Ashok Leyland Buses
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Ashok Leyland Buses and confirm the page heading and at least one listing card CTA. Filter By is checked when that row is present.

**Expected Result:**
Page heading is visible and at least one listing card button is shown.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Ashok Leyland Buses page
2. Verify the page heading
3. Verify listing cards (and Filter By when present)
